definitions.gloss: large-leaf maple, a maple variety with notably larger leaves
definitions.explanation: A maple variety (Acer pictum subsp. mono) with leaves noticeably larger than those of the common {伊呂波楓|いろはもみじ}. Grown in parks and along streets rather than small gardens.

examples.japanese: ⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{大楓|おおかえで}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{植|う}えられている。
examples.english: Large-leaf maples are planted in the park.

examples.japanese: {大楓|おおかえで}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{葉|は}→葉：02241_ha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{伊呂波楓|いろはもみじ}→伊呂波楓：30874_irohamomiji⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧。
examples.english: The leaves of the ookaede are larger than those of the iroha-momiji.

examples.japanese: ⟦{並木道|なみきみち}→並木道：17520_namikimichi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{大楓|おおかえで}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{並|なら}んで→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧いて、⟦{秋|あき}→秋：02276_aki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{黄色|きいろ}く→黄色い：00959_kiiroi⟧⟦{色|いろ}づく→色づく：10074_irozuku⟧。
examples.english: Large-leaf maples line the tree-lined street and turn yellow in autumn.

notes:
A maple variety named for its unusually large leaves, in contrast to the small, deeply cut leaves of the common ⟦{伊呂波楓|いろはもみじ}→伊呂波楓：30874_irohamomiji⟧. Its leaves turn yellow rather than the bright red typical of smaller maples.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{伊呂波楓|いろはもみじ}→伊呂波楓：30874_irohamomiji⟧: the standard small-leaved Japanese maple most people picture when they hear ⟦{楓|かえで}→楓：04375_kaede⟧
- ⟦{楓|かえで}→楓：04375_kaede⟧: the general word covering all maple species, including this one
